verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only reference-style docs for individual features (quickstart, function calling, prompt caching, moderation, etc.) but no explicit cookbook repository or worked end-to-end tutorial combining multiple calls into a real task. No citation labels any resource as a 'cookbook' or multi-step worked example; the closest is a 'first API request' quickstart, which is itself a single-call snippet, the opposite of what the story asks for.
